instruction: Extract from the file Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-3.pdf: for each billed line, the date, billed hours or start/end times, and any notes (query: billed visits/hours per date; schema: date, start, end, hours, notes).
List cameras (ug-surveillance cameras) so I can identify the Front Door camera id.
ug-document extract --file "Invoices/Ana Ruiz - Nov 2-3.pdf" --query "billed visits: date, start time, end time, hours, notes" --schema "[{date, start, end, hours, notes}]"
ug-surveillance event-timeline --camera-id "Front Door" --start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00 --end-time 2026-11-04T00:00:00 --timezone America/New_York --topic Human --identity-type all --limit 100

ug-surveillance event-timeline --camera-id "Front Door" --start-time 2026-11-02T00:00:00 --end-time 2026-11-03T00:00:00 --timezone America/New_York --topic Human --identity-type known --person-name "Ana Ruiz" --limit 100
